question: Should this Feishu pairing failure be handled in OpenClaw runtime, the Feishu plugin, or as a narrower ClawHub API gap?
rationale: The reported command and pending-pairing state are outside this checkout, while ClawHub only exposes catalog, package, skill, and CLI device-login surfaces; automation cannot choose the owning product surface safely.

options.title: Route to runtime/plugin triage
options.body: Treat this as an OpenClaw runtime or Feishu plugin pairing-state issue unless that investigation identifies a concrete ClawHub API dependency.

options.title: Open a narrow ClawHub API task
options.body: Keep ClawHub ownership only if runtime triage proves pairing depends on a missing registry, package, or install API here.

options.title: Close after external proof
options.body: Close this issue only after a runtime/plugin fix lands or maintainer proof shows current OpenClaw pairing no longer fails.

recommendation.title: Route to runtime/plugin triage
recommendation.body: Treat this as an OpenClaw runtime or Feishu plugin pairing-state issue unless that investigation identifies a concrete ClawHub API dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current-main trail through the ClawHub CLI/package/auth boundary that determines whether this belongs in this repository.
